Politics is the process by which groups of people make decisions on behalf of governing a specific society. [ 1 ] The term usually refers to actions pertaining to  civil governments , but the word has also been applied to other areas of human group interactions, including corporate , academic , and religious institutions. Politics consists of social relations involving authority or power.  Topics related to this area include political philosophy , which seeks a rationale for politics and answers regarding the best form of society, and public administration , which examines the practices of governance. [ 2 ]
